scope: Phase 8 backend-only operational summary and dashboard input definitions

operatorRead.authorization: The existing restricted operator controls the worker credential. Portfolio exports and durable retention progress are scoped to the explicit Portfolio ID; queue summaries and retention failure logs are separately labeled system-wide because their rows have no durable Portfolio ownership. The fixed system purpose and shipwithali_worker database role gate access; application, anon, and authenticated callers are denied.
operatorRead.phase10Provisioning: Phase 10 owns credentials, log collection, dashboard destinations, and alert delivery. This definition installs none of them.

bounds.queueScope: System-wide operations queue state. Queue rows have no Portfolio authority key and are never attributed to the requested Portfolio.
bounds.portfolioScope: The selected Portfolio applies to owner exports and durable retention/aggregate progress; retention failure log counts remain system-wide and are not attributed to it.

labels.values: Finite source-code enums only; Portfolio, event, export, lease, and job identifiers are never labels.

unknownSemantics: A missing producer, uninstalled provider, or absent durable watermark is state=unknown. It is never serialized as zero, complete, ready, or healthy. A measured zero is emitted only when the bounded source query ran and found no matching rows.

signals.meaning: Observed requests grouped by fixed handler family.
signals.source: Safe handler observations; centralized log aggregation is a Phase 10 handoff.
signals.bounds: Nineteen finite handler-family labels and four status values; at most 1000 records and nineteen result groups; no URL or identity labels.
signals.unknown: Unknown until the complete bounded handler observation source is configured.

signals.meaning: Maximum request duration at the existing handler boundary.
signals.source: Safe handler observations.
signals.bounds: Duration clamped to 24 hours; at most 1000 candidates and one result.
signals.unknown: Unknown without a complete collected handler observation window.

signals.meaning: Responses grouped as 2xx, 3xx, 4xx, or 5xx.
signals.source: Safe handler observations.
signals.bounds: Four fixed status values; at most 1000 candidates and four results.
signals.unknown: Unknown without a complete collected handler observation window.

signals.meaning: Checked-out connections from the application pool at acquire/remove events.
signals.source: PostgreSQL runtime pool acquire/remove observation; emitted to the restricted operations.signal log.
signals.bounds: One bounded integer sample per pool acquire/remove; values are limited to 0..1000; at most 1000 candidates.
signals.unknown: Unknown until a current complete restricted log sample is available; provider capacity remains unknown.

signals.meaning: Configured application pool maximum; this is not the provider plan limit.
signals.source: PostgreSQL runtime pool acquire/remove observation; configuredLimit is emitted separately from the unknown provider limit.
signals.bounds: Configured integer is limited to 1..1000; at most 1000 candidates. Provider capacity remains separate.
signals.unknown: Unknown until a current complete restricted log sample is available; provider capacity remains unknown.

signals.meaning: Safe failures thrown by transaction operations, excluding authorization and pool failures.
signals.source: PostgreSQL transaction runner observations in the restricted operations.signal log.
signals.bounds: Fixed category filter; no SQL text, SQLSTATE string, provider error, row, or identity labels. At most 1000 candidates.
signals.unknown: Unknown until restricted failure logs are completely collected; an observed zero is distinct from unavailable collection.

signals.meaning: Observed PostgreSQL authorization failures, including RLS denials.
signals.source: PostgreSQL transaction runner maps SQLSTATE 42501 to authorization in the restricted operations.signal log.
signals.bounds: Fixed authorization category; at most 1000 candidates; no SQLSTATE, row, identity, or query labels.
signals.unknown: Unknown until a complete restricted failure log window is collected.

signals.meaning: Errors reported for idle or checked-out PostgreSQL pool connections, separate from transaction failures.
signals.source: PostgreSQL runtime pool error observations in the restricted operations.signal log.
signals.bounds: Fixed pool category; at most 1000 candidates; no SQL text, SQLSTATE, provider error, row, or identity labels.
signals.unknown: Unknown until a complete restricted failure log window is collected.

signals.meaning: System-wide uncompleted, non-dead events whose available_at is not in the future; leased events remain outstanding.
signals.source: operations.outbox_events (system-wide; rows have no Portfolio ownership key).
signals.query: Scan at most 1001 pending rows in occurred_at,event_id order using outbox_events_operational_summary_eligible_idx, then count eligible rows in that prefix.
signals.bounds: Returns a bounded lower-bound sample; capped=true whenever more than 1000 pending candidates exist, even if fewer sampled rows are eligible.
signals.unknown: A measured zero is exact only when the bounded candidate set is complete; capped zero means zero eligible rows in the sampled prefix, not a healthy empty queue.
signals.drilldown: Restricted system-wide event/lease records by authorized operator.

signals.meaning: Age of the oldest observed eligible system-wide event, measured from occurred_at rather than retry available_at.
signals.source: operations.outbox_events.occurred_at and available_at (system-wide queue).
signals.query: Filter the bounded 1001-row oldest-pending prefix by available_at <= observedAt, then measure observedAt - minimum occurred_at.
signals.bounds: The index traversal is limited to 1001 pending rows. The age is exact if an eligible row occurs in that prefix; if no sampled eligible row is found while the prefix is capped, the value is unknown.
signals.unknown: Unknown when candidate coverage is incomplete and no eligible row is found; measured null means a complete candidate set has no eligible event.
signals.drilldown: Restricted system-wide event/lease records by authorized operator.

signals.meaning: Uncompleted, non-dead events whose available_at is later than the observed time.
signals.source: operations.outbox_events.available_at.
signals.query: Available-time index, LIMIT 1000.
signals.bounds: Values at the limit are marked capped.
signals.unknown: Measured zero only after the query returns no delayed rows.
signals.drilldown: Restricted event/lease records by authorized operator.

signals.meaning: Uncompleted, non-dead events with one or more prior attempts, including future-delayed retries.
signals.source: operations.outbox_events.attempt_count.
signals.query: Retry partial index, LIMIT 1000.
signals.bounds: Values at the limit are marked capped.
signals.unknown: Measured zero only after the query returns no retry rows.
signals.drilldown: Restricted safe retry state; never expose payloads.

signals.meaning: Terminal outbox events retained outside the eligible queue.
signals.source: operations.outbox_events.dead_at.
signals.query: Dead-state partial index, LIMIT 1000.
signals.bounds: Values at the limit are marked capped.
signals.unknown: Measured zero only after the query returns no dead rows.

signals.meaning: Outstanding outbox events with a lease that has not expired at observedAt.
signals.source: operations.outbox_events.lease_expires_at.
signals.query: Lease-expiry partial index, LIMIT 1000.
signals.bounds: Completed and dead events are excluded; sampled values are capped.
signals.unknown: Measured zero only after the bounded query finds no active event leases.

signals.meaning: Uncompleted, non-dead outbox events whose lease expired at or before observedAt.
signals.source: operations.outbox_events.lease_expires_at.
signals.query: Lease-expiry partial index, LIMIT 1000.
signals.bounds: Completed and dead events are excluded; sampled values are capped.
signals.unknown: Measured zero only after the bounded query finds no expired event leases.

signals.meaning: Rows whose durable job status is available; this status count includes future available_at values.
signals.source: operations.jobs.status and available_at.
signals.query: Status/available-time partial index, LIMIT 1000.
signals.bounds: Status is distinct from whether PostgreSQL currently considers a job claimable.
signals.unknown: Measured zero only after the bounded state query returns no available jobs.

signals.meaning: Rows in leased status, including unexpired and expired leases.
signals.source: operations.jobs.status and lease_expires_at.
signals.query: Lease-expiry index, LIMIT 1000.
signals.bounds: Active and expired lease counts are separate fields.
signals.unknown: Measured zero only after the bounded state query returns no leased jobs.

signals.meaning: Terminal jobs in dead status.
signals.source: operations.jobs.status.
signals.query: Status/available-time index, LIMIT 1000.
signals.bounds: No job payload or safe failure label appears as a metric label.
signals.unknown: Measured zero only after the bounded state query returns no dead jobs.
signals.drilldown: Restricted incident and audited recovery tooling.

signals.meaning: Jobs still in leased status whose lease expired at or before observedAt.
signals.source: operations.jobs.status and lease_expires_at.
signals.query: Lease-expiry partial index, LIMIT 1000.
signals.bounds: Only leased jobs are sampled; values at the limit are capped.
signals.unknown: Measured zero only after the bounded query finds no expired job leases.

signals.meaning: Maximum nonnegative time since acquisition across active system-wide outbox/job leases when both active sets are complete.
signals.source: operations.outbox_events.lease_acquired_at and operations.jobs.lease_acquired_at, populated when workers acquire or reclaim a lease.
signals.query: Filter lease_expires_at > observedAt, read at most 1001 active candidates per source in expiry/id order from the lease indexes, then compute max(greatest(0, observedAt - lease_acquired_at)).
signals.bounds: Index range reads are limited to 1001 active candidates per source. Any active lease missing acquisition time or more than 1000 active candidates makes age unknown; expired leases do not affect age. Values remain nonnegative when the application clock lags PostgreSQL.
signals.unknown: Unknown when any active lease lacks acquisition time or either active set exceeds the bounded sample; no active leases means measured null.

signals.meaning: Leased outbox events and jobs whose lease_expires_at is at or before observedAt.
signals.source: operations.outbox_events and operations.jobs.
signals.query: Lease-expiry partial indexes, LIMIT 1000 per source.
signals.bounds: Event and job counts remain separate.
signals.unknown: Measured zero only after both source queries return no expired leases.

signals.meaning: Expired jobs/outbox events reclaimed by a successful committed worker claim.
signals.source: PostgreSQL operations lease claim adapters emit reclaimed count and maximum prior lease age after commit.
signals.bounds: At most 1000 candidates; counts are limited to 1..1000000 per observation and the sum is bounded; no worker or row IDs.
signals.unknown: Unknown until the complete restricted worker log window is collected.

signals.meaning: Fenced state transitions rejected because the lease expired or was replaced.
signals.source: PostgreSQL operations transition adapters emit stale-write after a failed durable compare-and-set.
signals.bounds: At most 1000 candidates; no lease token, job ID, payload, or worker ID labels.
signals.unknown: Unknown until the complete restricted worker log window is collected.

signals.meaning: Current requested/building counts plus ready/failed/expired transitions during the last 24 hours for the selected Portfolio.
signals.source: portability.owner_exports.
signals.query: Use bounded per-state queries: requested/building rows with requested_at <= observedAt; ready, failed, and expired rows with completed_at, failed_at, and expired_at respectively inside [observedAt - 24 hours, observedAt].
signals.bounds: Portfolio/status/requested index for active states and portfolio/transition-time partial indexes for terminal states; at most 1000 rows per state. sampleCount sums all five bounded state buckets (0..5000); capped is true if any bucket reaches 1000.
signals.unknown: Measured zero only after every bounded state query succeeds and returns no rows.
signals.drilldown: Restricted export state by authorized operator.

signals.meaning: Maximum build duration among at most 1000 ready exports completed during the bounded 24-hour transition window.
signals.source: portability.owner_exports.started_at/completed_at.
signals.query: Maximum completed_at - started_at over recent ready rows selected by the portfolio/completed_at index.
signals.bounds: The duration uses at most 1000 recent ready completions. exports.sampleCount still sums all five bounded state buckets (0..5000); capped reports any bucket at its 1000-row limit.
signals.unknown: Unknown when the complete bounded window has no completed build.
signals.drilldown: Restricted export state by authorized operator.

signals.meaning: Stored artifact bytes represented by the bounded recent ready-completion sample.
signals.source: portability.owner_exports.artifact_content_length.
signals.query: Sum artifact_content_length for at most 1000 ready exports completed in the window.
signals.bounds: Bytes use only the bounded ready rows; sampleCount sums all five per-state buckets (0..5000), while capped reports any bucket reaching 1000.
signals.unknown: Unknown if artifact length is missing; no bytes are invented.
signals.drilldown: Restricted export state by authorized operator.

signals.meaning: Recent ready Owner Export builds whose artifact bytes passed owning assembly verification; this does not report download-time stream integrity.
signals.source: portability.owner_exports.status=ready.
signals.query: Count bounded recent ready states selected by completed_at.
signals.bounds: Portfolio/completed_at partial index; no digests or object identities are emitted.
signals.unknown: Unknown if the bounded source query fails.
signals.drilldown: Portfolio-scoped build state only; no object-level identifiers or digests.

signals.meaning: Failed Owner Export artifact length or digest checks during assembly verification or a later download stream in the recent log window.
signals.source: Safe owner-export-integrity observations from operations.signal; these records have no Portfolio authority key or build/download phase field.
signals.window: 15 minutes ending at the summary snapshot observedAt
signals.bounds: Fixed 15-minute query, at most 1000 candidates and one result; permits only verified/failed outcome fields and emits no Portfolio, export, object, URL, or exception details.
signals.unknown: Unknown when the restricted system-wide log source is absent, incomplete, malformed, capped, or unavailable; only a complete valid window may report zero.
signals.drilldown: Restricted system-wide failure count only; it is not attributed to the selected Portfolio.

signals.meaning: Publication dependency or transaction failures grouped by fixed category.
signals.source: Content authoring service observes its publication execution result and transaction exception at the owning boundary.
signals.bounds: Two fixed categories; at most 1000 candidates; no content IDs, URLs, content, provider errors, or exception strings.
signals.unknown: Unknown until the complete restricted worker log window is collected.

signals.meaning: Public measurement events accepted after consent verification.
signals.source: Public event HTTP and owning ingestion service observations.
signals.bounds: At most 1000 candidates; no Visitor, subject, event, or URL labels.
signals.unknown: Unknown until the complete safe observation log source is collected.

signals.meaning: Events explicitly dropped by an owning ingestion operation, if that operation returns a distinct drop outcome.
signals.source: The current owning measurement intake contract has no distinct drop result; its handler records accepted, rejected, unavailable, or indeterminate. No drop producer is installed.
signals.bounds: At most 1000 candidates; no consent token, event body, identity, or HTTP label is attached to the intake outcome.
signals.unknown: Always unknown under the current owning contract, even when the generic event-intake log window is complete. Missing or incomplete collection also remains unknown.

signals.meaning: Difference between requiredThroughPeriod and durable aggregateFinishedThrough; lastFinishedPeriod is null until that cursor reaches firstPolicyPeriod.
signals.source: operations.phase7_schedule_progress for the selected Portfolio.
signals.query: One primary-key row; use stored contiguous cursors, not a recent-job reconstruction.
signals.bounds: Single-row lookup.
signals.unknown: Unknown when no durable cursor exists. When the row exists but aggregateFinishedThrough is before firstPolicyPeriod, lastFinishedPeriod is null while the measured aggregate backlog remains available.

signals.meaning: Last contiguous policy period whose retention and aggregate coverage completed.
signals.source: operations.phase7_schedule_progress.last_complete_period.
signals.query: One primary-key row for the selected Portfolio.
signals.bounds: No arbitrary historical scan.
signals.unknown: Unknown when no durable cursor exists or last_complete_period is before firstPolicyPeriod; the latter means no policy period has completed.
signals.drilldown: Restricted durable schedule cursor and bounded incomplete keys.

signals.meaning: Required-through retention period minus contiguous retention completion watermark.
signals.source: operations.phase7_schedule_progress.
signals.query: Date difference from one primary-key row.
signals.bounds: Clamped at zero; incomplete older holes hold the watermark behind.
signals.unknown: Unknown when no durable cursor exists.

signals.meaning: Due-work retention operations whose terminal failure transition committed in the fixed 15-minute window; completed and incomplete attempts do not count.
signals.source: Safe retention-work observations in the restricted operations.signal log. The signal has no Portfolio attribution.
signals.window: 15 minutes ending at the summary snapshot observedAt
signals.bounds: Fixed query over at most 1000 candidates and one result; only measurement/feedback domain, completed/incomplete/failed outcome, and processed 0..1000000 are accepted. No identifiers or provider details.
signals.unknown: Unknown when the restricted log source is absent, uninstalled, incomplete, malformed, over cap, or unavailable; zero is measured only for a complete valid window.
signals.drilldown: Restricted system-wide failure count only; never attribute it to the selected Portfolio.

signals.meaning: Safe private object-storage read/write/delete outcomes.
signals.source: Owning export storage operation observations.
signals.bounds: At most 1000 candidates; no bucket, object key, signed URL, or provider error labels.
signals.unknown: Unknown until the complete safe observation log source is collected.

signals.meaning: Observed private object-storage operation health, not an active provider probe or configuration check.
signals.source: Owning export storage adapters emit safe read/write/delete outcome observations to the restricted operations.signal log.
signals.bounds: The bounded states use only safe outcomes and at most 1000 candidates; storage outage does not alone make core database readiness unready.
signals.unknown: Unknown when the restricted log source is absent or no operation occurred in the window; unavailable is reserved for a future provider probe.
signals.drilldown: Restricted storage operation outcomes; no bucket, object key, signed URL, or provider error.

signals.meaning: Age from the relational source-data watermark to observation time; alert when older than the independent 24-hour RPO.
signals.source: Real relational backup producer owned by #253; not wired.
signals.query: Source watermark timestamp from the latest complete verified relational backup catalog row.
signals.bounds: One latest complete relational catalog row; use source-data watermark, never upload completion time.
signals.unknown: Unknown until isolated real relational backup producer evidence exists.

signals.meaning: Age from the object/export source-data watermark to observation time; alert when older than the independent 168-hour RPO.
signals.source: Real object backup producer owned by #254; not wired.
signals.query: Source watermark timestamp from the latest complete verified object backup catalog row.
signals.bounds: One latest complete object catalog row; use source-data watermark, never upload completion time.
signals.unknown: Unknown until isolated real object backup producer evidence exists.

signals.meaning: Verified backup objects in a complete source-consistent backup set.
signals.source: Real backup producer owned by #253/#254; not wired.
signals.query: Verified catalog counts only.
signals.bounds: Partial uploads never count as usable.
signals.unknown: Unknown until a real producer is wired.

signals.meaning: Verified relational/object backup bytes.
signals.source: Real backup producer owned by #253/#254; not wired.
signals.query: Verified catalog bytes only.
signals.bounds: No plaintext content or key material.
signals.unknown: Unknown until a real producer is wired.

signals.meaning: Whether the verified backup set is complete, incomplete, or failed.
signals.source: Real backup producer owned by #253/#254; not wired.
signals.query: Durable catalog state.
signals.bounds: Only a completed read-back/integrity verification may be complete.
signals.unknown: Unknown until a real producer is wired.

signals.meaning: Current isolated recovery rehearsal stage.
signals.source: Real recovery producer owned by #255; not wired.
signals.query: Durable real rehearsal observations.
signals.bounds: No production restore or fake healthy status.
signals.unknown: Unknown until a real isolated rehearsal producer is wired.

signals.meaning: Terminal outcome of an isolated recovery rehearsal, including an actual failed stage.
signals.source: Real recovery rehearsal outcome producer owned by #255; not wired.
signals.query: Durable terminal rehearsal result.
signals.bounds: Only a real isolated rehearsal result can report failed or complete.
signals.unknown: Unknown until a real isolated rehearsal producer is wired.

signals.meaning: Complete measured recovery duration, including access, restore, reconciliation, and readiness stages.
signals.source: Real recovery producer owned by #255; not wired.
signals.query: End-to-end measured stage duration.
signals.bounds: Stage durations remain separate from full RTO.
signals.unknown: Unknown until a real isolated rehearsal producer is wired.

signals.meaning: Required database/application dependency readiness; optional export/alert/backup outages are separately degraded.
signals.source: Runtime readiness probes.
signals.query: Non-destructive readiness result.
signals.bounds: No backup, restore, secret, provider detail, or unbounded queue scan.
signals.unknown: Unknown until readiness observations are collected.

signals.meaning: Measured resource numerator divided by its known configured/provider limit.
signals.source: A producer supplying both current numerator and limit.
signals.query: 100 * used / limit, only when both are current and limit > 0.
signals.bounds: Never infer a limit from a plan tier or default.
signals.unknown: Unknown unless both numerator and limit are measured.

signals.meaning: Durable isolated incident delivery lifecycle state.
signals.source: operations.incidents delivery_state and next_delivery_at.
signals.query: Restricted authorized listing with fixed field projection and LIMIT 100.
signals.bounds: No source identity, internal scope key, delivery payload, provider response, or stack is projected.
signals.unknown: Unknown when current incident schema or restricted database access is unavailable.

signals.meaning: A sustained burn, authorization, integration, or downstream gate measurement compared with its explicitly configured limit.
signals.source: Validated operator rule configuration and complete bounded observations.
signals.query: Only evaluate when the configured minimum sample count covers at least 80 percent of the rule window; every current sample must strictly exceed the threshold.
signals.bounds: At most 100 samples; explicit unit, owner, safe code, runbook pointer, bounded window, and minimum sample count are required.
signals.unknown: Unknown until both configuration and measurement window are complete.

alerts.action: Inspect safe handler/retry/dead state and recover the owning blockage.
alerts.unknown: No eligible item is no alert; unknown collection is not healthy.

alerts.action: Inspect the safe terminal cause and audited recovery path.
alerts.unknown: Unknown queue data is not zero.

alerts.action: Protect dependent aggregate/export work and repair the owning module.
alerts.unknown: Unknown is not a healthy zero; failure counts are system-wide and are not attributed to a Portfolio.

alerts.action: Inspect the bounded safe publication failure category and preserve last-valid publication.
alerts.unknown: Unknown is not a healthy zero.

alerts.action: Block recovery qualification and preserve the last verified relational backup set.
alerts.unknown: Unknown until #253 wires real relational source-watermark evidence.

alerts.action: Block recovery qualification and reconcile the compatible object set.
alerts.unknown: Unknown until #254 wires real object source-watermark evidence.

alerts.action: Mark recovery qualification failed and retain the release blocker.
alerts.unknown: Unknown until #255 wires a real isolated rehearsal.

alerts.action: Review current measured capacity and take the documented operator action.
alerts.unknown: Evaluate only when both numerator and nonzero limit are known.

alerts.action: Inspect the restricted incident record and repair the isolated delivery sink; do not create a second alert for this delivery failure.
alerts.unknown: Unknown when current incident schema or restricted database access is unavailable.

alerts.condition: configured.sustained_rule > its validated threshold in every sample over the configured window
alerts.action: Use the rule's owning role and validated runbook pointer; incomplete windows remain unknown.
alerts.unknown: Unknown until a threshold, unit, owner, runbook pointer, bounded window, and minimum sample count are all configured and measured.

downstream.incidentLifecycle: #252 owns incident delivery, deduplication, recovery, and alert lifecycle. Delivery retries are capped at eight with bounded backoff; failed notification never creates another incident.
downstream.incidentRunbook: docs/operations/phase8-incidents-252.md defines operator roles, remediation pointers, unknown handling, retry bounds, and downstream deployment handoffs.
downstream.backupProducers: #253-#255 own real backup and recovery producers; synthetic observation fixtures do not complete their evidence.
downstream.integratedGate: #256 rejects missing live isolated producer evidence.
downstream.operatorCli: npm run operations:summary -- --portfolio-id <Portfolio UUID> requires the explicit Portfolio scope. OPERATIONS_SUMMARY_PORTFOLIO_ID may be omitted or must match the flag. The CLI uses DATABASE_URL for the existing restricted worker credential. Portfolio scope applies to database export state and durable retention progress; queue summaries and unscoped runtime log observations such as export integrity and retention failures are system-wide rather than Portfolio-attributed.
downstream.installation: Phase 10 owns production credentials, log aggregation, dashboards, schedules, and alert destinations.
